headline: Contested Fronts Stir as Ownership Shifts Continue
war_summary: The latest watch finds the ownership ledger most unsettled on Stlican Shelf, where two fresh changes bring the 24-hour total to 39 amid nine bases split five Warden, three Colonial, and one neutral. Godcrofts has also quickened, posting four events in two hours and nine across the day, with control standing six Warden to three Colonial. Stonecradle records four new changes in the latest watch and 18 over 24 hours; its holdings remain seven Warden and two Colonial. Deadlands has nine changes in six hours and 18 for the day, with the Colonial side holding nine of eleven bases. Weathered Expanse remains a major battered sector, though no ownership movement appears in the latest two-hour window; its 22 daily events leave six Warden and three Colonial bases. Fisherman’s Row shows six daily changes, including two recent captures, and remains heavily Warden-held at eight bases to one. Callahan’s Passage has five daily events but no fresh movement in two hours, while the quieter sectors continue to show little evidence of imminent strategic-base turnover.
